title: On Identifying the bird by its call
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：identify　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 identify 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the coach ① identified the bird by its call without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② identifies the bird by its call at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ identify the bird by its call at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ identified the bird by its call before — a line in the record for April 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Identifying the bird by its call without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ identify the dead man within an hour at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Identify the dead man within an hour at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ identifies the dead man within an hour without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ identified the bird by its call again when nobody else would.

⑩ To identify the bird by its call, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody identifies the bird by its call at once again and somebody must identify the bird by its call without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 认出（一般过去式 identified the bird by its call：1988 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 认出（一般现在 identifies the bird by its call：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 认出（不定式 to identify the bird by its call：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 认出（过去完成时 had identified the bird by its call：1982 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 认出（动名词 identifying the bird by its call 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 查明（identify the dead man within an hour：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去查明一个钟头内查明死者是谁）
G. v. 查明（identify the dead man within an hour：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 认出（后段两处：新来的队员照例 identifies the dead man within an hour，而母亲又一次 identified the bird by its call）

identify 意为“认出”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例查明一个钟头内查明死者是谁，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 identifies。

identify 意为“认出”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要认出凭叫声认出那只鸟，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 identify 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the coach identified the bird by its call without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach identifies the bird by its call at once whenever the field asks.
Identifying the bird by its call without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever identify the dead man within an hour at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.

When nobody else would, my mother identified the bird by its call again, and the field remembered that half.
